verse.text: Then as I looked over the situation, I called together the nobles and the rest of the people and said to them, "Don't be afraid of the enemy! Remember the Lord, who is great and glorious, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your homes!"

video.title: Welcome to the Family! - Daily Devotion

reflection: Nehemiah didn't wait for someone else to protect his people — he stood up, looked at the threat honestly, and rallied the men around him to guard their homes. That's the daily call for a dad too: you may not face swords and spears, but you're still the one who has to notice the dangers creeping toward your family — busyness, distraction, bad influences — and stand in the gap. Courage for a man rarely looks dramatic; it looks like showing up, staying alert, and refusing to let fear talk you out of defending the people God gave you.
